title: A point redraws every viewer at 30 fps
body:
While a `point` is active, a 33 ms timer in `src/server/compositor.rs` (`PULSE_EVERY`, `start_pulse`) requests a redraw, and every viewer redraws at about 30 frames a second, not only the viewer showing the pulsing pane, pill, card or tile. The pulse lasts up to 30 s.

## Proposal

Redraw only the viewers whose shown workspace draws the pulse: the pointed pane's workspace, and any viewer whose sidebar or rail shows that workspace's card or tile. A viewer with the sidebar closed and another workspace shown still draws the rail tile, so it still redraws.
